folderName.title: Download folder name
folderName.description: Folder inside the user's Downloads folder where files are saved.

filenameTemplate.title: File name pattern
filenameTemplate.description: Relative path for each file. Tokens: {filename} {name} {ext} {site} {title} {date} {kind}. Use / for subfolders.

saveAs.title: Ask where to save each file

showPlaylists.title: Show streaming playlists as unsupported items

language.title: Interface language
language.description: One of: auto, en, ha, yo, ig, pcm.

blockedHosts.title: Blocked hosts
blockedHosts.description: Added to the user's blocklist. Users cannot remove these.

allowlistHosts.title: Allowlist hosts
allowlistHosts.description: When set, only these hosts are scanned. Replaces the user's allowlist.
